title: Lindsay Clancy jurors say holdout had ‘reasonable doubt’
text:
Three jurors in the Lindsay Clancy trial spoke out for the first time after a judge declared a mistrial, describing the frustration of trying to reach a unanimous verdict with one holdout juror who they said acknowledged having “reasonable doubt.”

“He admitted he had reasonable doubt, and I started filling out the forms. I was so excited,” jury foreperson Roni Carlson told Boston NBC10 in an interview alongside two other female jurors.
